text: The Malo website (malo.fr) is published by SILL ENTREPRISES (SAS, RCS Brest 636 220 220, Plouvien). The company register lists SILL ENTREPRISES as Président de SAS of LAITERIE DE SAINT MALO (SIREN 895780377, 9 rue du Clos du Noyer, Saint-Malo), with Henri León as Directeur Général. The club's partner page for Malo gives the same Saint-Malo address.
short: The Malo dairy is chaired by SILL Entreprises, which also publishes the Malo website.
